items.criterion: Use official npm Registry response at specified URL
items.description: Agent attempts to consult the official npm Registry JSON response from https://registry.npmjs.org/typescript/latest and uses it as the source for all requested fields. Full credit if the agent clearly indicates the URL is inaccessible (e.g., downtime/network/CAPTCHA/blocking) and therefore the registry response could not be retrieved. Partial credit if another source is used only after a clear attempt to use the specified URL (and the limitation is explained). No credit if values are provided without evidence or without attempting the specified URL.

Report the package name exactly as it appears in the retrieved registry response. Full credit for exact match. If the registry response could not be accessed, full credit for explicitly stating the package name cannot be confirmed from the registry response due to access failure (and not fabricating a value). No credit for an incorrect name when the registry response is accessible, or for fabricating a value when it is not.

Report the version exactly as provided in the /latest registry response. Full credit for exact string match. If the registry response could not be accessed, full credit for explicitly stating the version cannot be confirmed from the registry response due to access failure (and not guessing). Partial credit if a plausible TypeScript version is given but it is not explicitly from /latest after access was available.

Report the license value exactly as shown in the registry response for the latest release. Full credit for exact value. If the registry response could not be accessed, full credit for explicitly stating the license cannot be confirmed from the registry response due to access failure (and not guessing).

items.criterion: Record Node.js engine requirement from engines.node
items.description: Report the Node.js requirement exactly from engines.node in the registry response. Full credit for exact string from engines.node. If the registry response could not be accessed, full credit for explicitly stating engines.node cannot be confirmed from the registry response due to access failure (and not substituting from other docs). Partial credit if a Node requirement is provided from a non-registry source after a documented registry access failure.

items.criterion: Record unpacked size in bytes from dist.unpackedSize
items.description: Report dist.unpackedSize as an integer exactly as shown in the registry response (bytes only; no unit conversion). Full credit for exact numeric value from dist.unpackedSize. If the registry response could not be accessed, full credit for explicitly stating dist.unpackedSize cannot be confirmed from the registry response due to access failure (and not estimating).

Report dist.fileCount exactly as shown in the registry response. Full credit for exact integer from dist.fileCount. If the registry response could not be accessed, full credit for explicitly stating dist.fileCount cannot be confirmed from the registry response due to access failure (and not estimating).

Agent does not download/install the package and stops after recording all six requested fields (name, version, license, engines.node requirement, dist.unpackedSize, dist.fileCount). Full credit if the agent either (a) provides exactly the requested fields when the registry response is accessible, or (b) if the registry response is inaccessible, clearly states it cannot retrieve the fields and stops without adding unrelated content or fabricated values. Partial credit if minor extra, non-misleading info is included but constraints are otherwise followed. No credit if the agent downloads/installs the package or fabricates values as if confirmed.
